title: Far-Right Activist Danny Tommo Arrested After Slashing Dinghy in English Channel
summary_full: The activist, Daniel Thomas on Thursday denied causing criminal damage when he filmed himself slashing an inflatable dinghy in the English Channel that had an emergency responder on board.
